eval: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('main .group > button'); if (!row) return 'no-track-row (library may be empty in this env)'; row.click(); return 'clicked-first-row'; })()
name: play-first

eval: (() => { const dock = [...document.querySelectorAll('footer')].find(f => f.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Trình phát thu nhỏ'); if (!dock) return 'mini-player:MISSING'; const btns = [...dock.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label')); return 'mini-player:OK buttons=' + btns.join(','); })()
name: mini-player

eval: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('footer')].find(f => f.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Trình phát thu nhỏ'); if (!d) return 'no-dock'; const r = d.getBoundingClientRect(); const nav = document.querySelector("nav[aria-label='Điều hướng chính']").getBoundingClientRect(); return 'dock: y=' + Math.round(r.y) + ' h=' + Math.round(r.height) + ' | bottomnav-top=' + Math.round(nav.y) + ' overlap=' + (r.bottom > nav.y && r.y < nav.bottom); })()
name: dock-vs-nav-overlap

eval: (() => { const pause = [...document.querySelectorAll('footer button')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Tạm dừng'); if (!pause) return 'no-pause-btn'; const r = pause.getBoundingClientRect(); return 'pause-btn: ' + Math.round(r.width) + 'x' + Math.round(r.height); })()
name: pause-size

eval: (() => { const pause = [...document.querySelectorAll('footer button')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Tạm dừng'); if (pause) { pause.click(); return 'paused'; } return 'no-pause-btn'; })()
name: pause

eval: (() => { const play = [...document.querySelectorAll('footer button')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Phát'); if (!play) return 'no-play-btn (state not updated?)'; play.click(); return 'resumed'; })()
name: resume

eval: (() => { const dock = [...document.querySelectorAll('footer')].find(f => f.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Trình phát thu nhỏ'); const stage = dock.querySelector('[role="button"]'); if (stage) { stage.click(); return 'expanded'; } return 'no-expand-target'; })()

eval: (() => { const fs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fixed.inset-0')].find(e => e.querySelector('h1')); if (!fs) return 'fullscreen-player:MISSING'; const lyricsBtn = [...fs.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').includes('lời')); const queueBtn = [...fs.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Hàng đợi'); const collapseBtn = [...fs.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Thu nhỏ trình phát'); return 'fullscreen:OK lyrics=' + !!lyricsBtn + ' queue=' + !!queueBtn + ' collapse=' + !!collapseBtn; })()
